items.title: Termination is equivalent to termination on right-forward closures for right-linear or locally confluent overlay TRSs
items.author: Rene Thiemann; Dieter Hofbauer; Ulysse Le Huitouze; Johannes Waldmann
items.source_version: Official published FSCD2026.32 Theorem3, with author-mapped complete AFP Right_Forward_Closures native proofs fixed at Git80985fd56a4cb63a90176bf4bfe456eaff949bfd retrieved2026-10-14
items.difficulty_reason: The authors construct invariant-guided infinite narrowing simulations of nonterminating rewriting. For right-linear systems this requires variable-disjoint most-general unification, linear-substitution control and a lifted step simulation; for locally confluent overlay systems it uses minimal nontermination, innermost rewriting and the Gramlich switch. Complete current linear-unification/narrowing/innermost support and both RFC proofs remain here. These non-routine constructions support H2 as one combined termination-equivalence theorem.
